name: pdfloveme-pdf-tests
description: Test harness for the PDF tools. Dev-only — the site itself ships no npm dependencies; everything it needs is vendored under /vendor. tools-smoke.test.mjs needs no npm packages at all: it drives headless Chrome through lib/cdp.mjs.

scripts.test: node run-tests.mjs && node coords.test.mjs && node font-coverage.test.mjs && node e2e.test.mjs && node render.test.mjs && node tools-smoke.test.mjs
